name: autodash-reels
description: Create car video reels from listing details and five photos, or recover existing AutoDash videos.

interface.longDescription: Create a silent 20-second vertical car reel from a listing link and five photos you upload. AutoDash saves listing details, prepares your photos and captions, and shows progress in a visual project card. Open its studio to reorder photos, edit captions or choose a video style. Render using your connected AutoDash account, then play and download the reel in chat. You can also recover videos you already made. Listing photos are not imported; narration, photo retouching and social publishing are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Make a car reel from my listing link.

positive.description: Onboarding question with no project yet.
positive.expected_behavior: The AutoDash guide card appears with its example reel. One short sentence explains a silent 20-second vertical reel from listing details and five uploaded photos and invites a listing URL. No web search, external images, unsupported narration offer or feature list.

positive.description: Download and attach the five numbered photos from https://autodashapp.com/review-fixtures/listing.html after the listing prompt, using the dedicated reviewer account. Wait for automatic captions and press Create reel. These licensed sample photos and fictional vehicle facts are review fixtures.
positive.prompt: Make a reel from this car listing: https://autodashapp.com/review-fixtures/listing.html
positive.tools_triggered: import_listing, import_photos, show_project; start_render from the explicit card button; component refresh_project
positive.expected_behavior: import_listing creates and populates one draft using a stable request_id and explicit English locale. The listing saves Volkswagen ID.4, 2021, 12,000 km and EUR 32,000; no web search or listing-photo import. Only the five attached files appear in supplied order. Wait until photo preparation and automatic captions are ready, then click Create reel. One new render reserves one existing credit; progress, playable silent 20-second vertical video and Download appear in the current project card. Save the actual MP4 and play it. No duplicate render from uncertain replies. Older-card folding depends on host communication.

positive.description: Use the dedicated reviewer account and the fictional demo listing with no price. After the assistant asks for price, answer: EUR 32,000.
positive.prompt: Use this listing for my reel: https://autodashapp.com/review-fixtures/listing-no-price.html
positive.expected_behavior: Found facts are saved; the assistant asks only for the missing price in one sentence and saves the answer with update_project. The existing card updates itself; no new card for the answer.

positive.description: Use the completed project from positive case 2. Request caption and order changes, then choose an exact style from the gallery. Also open the studio and verify the refreshed caption. No new render is requested.
positive.prompt: Change the third caption to “Ready for the road”, put the last photo first, and show me the other video styles.
positive.tools_triggered: get_project, save_captions (asset-bound patches with same-five atomic order), list_templates, update_project; component refresh_project
positive.expected_behavior: Read the project and identify the original third photo by asset_id. Save its edited headline with its original field base and explicit locale, plus the proposed same-five order and selected_asset_ids base order in one save_captions call. The text remains attached to that photo after the last photo moves first. Choosing a style saves its exact ID. The studio reads saved text; unsaved local fields remain intact. No new render/debit. On a conflicting field, show current saved text and retained draft for explicit selected reapply rather than silently overwriting.

positive.description: Use the owned completed render from positive case 2. Reopen the chat after the prior ten-minute link expires. Compare the actual balance before and after; use the existing video, not a new render.
positive.prompt: Find my last AutoDash reel and give me a fresh download.
positive.expected_behavior: One video card recovers the existing owned render with playable video and a fresh authoritative Download button. Save and play the MP4. No render starts and no additional credit is reserved. Do not reconstruct signed links.

negative.description: No photos attached. Listing photos are never imported; no render may start without five uploaded photos. Do not fabricate attachments or bypass blocked pages.
negative.prompt: Turn this listing into a reel without me uploading photos: https://autodashapp.com/review-fixtures/listing.html

negative.description: Social publishing is unsupported. Explain that the video can be downloaded; do not claim publication or suggest posting.
negative.prompt: Publish this reel to Instagram and TikTok for me.

negative.description: Photo retouching is unsupported. Explain the limitation; do not claim edited photos or start a paid render.
negative.prompt: Remove damage and change the car's paint colour in these photos before creating the video.

review.commerce_description: The plugin uses the connected account’s existing credits and does not sell credits, start checkout, offer upgrades or publish to social platforms. The AutoDash website separately offers credit purchases.

publication.release_notes: Updates the package instructions for concise unsupported-feature refusals and failed-listing recovery. Companion production fixes preserve signed MP4 downloads through ChatGPT, recover an active render without another charge, avoid empty drafts after failed imports, and refresh chat edits faster in component v11. Sign-in uses the server's standard OAuth discovery instead of explicit endpoint overrides.
